facts.activity_file: testing earth leakage and protection settings

control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - management of change not applied to TX-3002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-3002 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. TX-3002 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 24 March 2020 a planned critical control verification of TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the earth leakage and protection setting integrity not effective.
